description.description: A side-by-side collage of three prominent female singers at gala events. On the left, Ariana Grande is shown from the back wearing a textured black off-the-shoulder gown with her hair in a high ponytail. In the middle, Selena Gomez is pictured over her shoulder wearing a white feathered boa and dark red lipstick. On the right, Miley Cyrus poses in a black sequined gown with oversized ruffled shoulders, wearing dark sunglasses and an emerald necklace.

A screenshot of an Instagram story posted by Selena Gomez. The story features a collage comparing the Powerpuff Girls in a stylized, older aesthetic (top) to real-life images of Miley Cyrus, Ariana Grande, and Selena Gomez (bottom). The top frame shows Bubbles, Blossom, and Buttercup with mature features, while the bottom frame shows red-carpet photos of the three singers. Text on the image expresses pride for the colleagues she grew up with, accompanied by tagged usernames and hearts.
